title: Joshua Chapter 14 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Joshua chapter 14 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Joshua Chapter 14 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Joshua Chapter 14.

questions.question: Who distributed the land of Canaan among the children of Israel?
options: Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes
questions.correctAnswer: Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:1 states that Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes distributed the land to the children of Israel.

questions.question: How was the land inheritance distributed among the tribes?
questions.correctAnswer: By lot
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:2 says the inheritance was distributed by lot as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

questions.question: Which tribes received their inheritance on the other side of Jordan?
options: Two tribes and a half tribe
questions.correctAnswer: Two tribes and a half tribe
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:3 explains that Moses gave the inheritance of two tribes and a half tribe on the other side of Jordan.

questions.question: Did the Levites receive an inheritance of land among the tribes?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:3 clearly states that the Levites were given no inheritance among the tribes.

questions.question: Which two tribes are called the children of Joseph?
questions.correctAnswer: Manasseh and Ephraim
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:4 identifies the children of Joseph as two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim.

questions.question: What was the Levites' portion in the land?
options: Cities to dwell in with suburbs for cattle and substance
questions.correctAnswer: Cities to dwell in with suburbs for cattle and substance
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:4 states that the Levites received no part in the land except cities to dwell in with their suburbs for cattle and substance.

questions.question: Did the children of Israel disobey the LORD’s command to divide the land?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:5 confirms that the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses and divided the land accordingly.

questions.question: Who came to Joshua in Gilgal from the tribe of Judah?
questions.correctAnswer: Caleb the son of Jephunneh
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:6 mentions that Caleb, from the tribe of Judah, came to Joshua in Gilgal.

questions.question: At what age was Caleb sent by Moses to spy out the land?
questions.correctAnswer: Forty years old
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:7 states Caleb was forty years old when Moses sent him to spy out the land.

questions.question: True or False: Caleb’s report made the hearts of the people strong and encouraged them.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:8 explains that Caleb’s brethren made the hearts of the people melt despite Caleb’s faithful report.

questions.question: What did Moses swear regarding the land Caleb’s feet had trodden?
options: That it shall be Caleb’s inheritance and his children’s forever
That it would be given to another tribe
That it would be left unoccupied
That Caleb would not inherit any land
questions.correctAnswer: That it shall be Caleb’s inheritance and his children’s forever
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:9 states Moses swore the land where Caleb’s feet trod would be his inheritance forever.

questions.question: How old was Caleb when he requested the mountain inheritance from Joshua?
questions.correctAnswer: Eighty-five years old
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:10 says Caleb was eighty-five years old when he made his request.

questions.question: True or False: Caleb said he was as strong at eighty-five as he was forty for war.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:11 records Caleb’s statement that he was as strong at eighty-five as he was at forty for going out and coming in war.

questions.question: What reason did Caleb give for requesting the mountain land where the Anakims were?
options: He believed the LORD would enable him to drive them out
He was afraid of the Anakims
questions.correctAnswer: He believed the LORD would enable him to drive them out
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:12 says Caleb requested the mountain land because if the LORD was with him, he would be able to drive out the Anakims.

questions.question: In Joshua 14, which event comes first?
options: The distribution of the land by lot
Moses giving inheritance on the other side Jordan
questions.correctAnswer: The distribution of the land by lot
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:2 describes the distribution of the land by lot before Caleb’s request or Joshua blessing him.

medium.title: Joshua Chapter 14 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Joshua Chapter 14 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Who accompanied Joshua in distributing the inheritance of the land of Canaan to the children of Israel?
options: Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers of the tribes
The Levites and the tribe of Joseph
questions.correctAnswer: Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers of the tribes
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:1 states that Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes distributed the land, showing the leadership involved in the division of inheritance.

questions.question: According to Joshua 14:2, how was the land of inheritance divided among the tribes?
options: By lot as the LORD commanded by Moses
By the decision of Joshua alone
By the elders of each tribe
questions.correctAnswer: By lot as the LORD commanded by Moses
questions.explanation: Verse 2 explains that the land was distributed by lot as the LORD commanded through Moses, emphasizing divine guidance in the process.

questions.question: True or False: The Levites received a portion of land as inheritance among the children of Israel.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:3 clearly states that the Levites received no inheritance of land among the tribes, distinguishing their role from the other tribes.

questions.question: What provision was made for the Levites since they did not receive land inheritance?
options: Cities to dwell in with their suburbs for cattle and substance
Fertile land along the Jordan River
questions.correctAnswer: Cities to dwell in with their suburbs for cattle and substance
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:4 states that the Levites were given cities to dwell in along with surrounding pasturelands, ensuring their needs were met despite no land inheritance.

questions.question: How did the children of Israel respond to the LORD's command regarding dividing the land?
options: They obeyed and divided the land accordingly
questions.correctAnswer: They obeyed and divided the land accordingly
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:5 confirms that the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses and divided the land, demonstrating obedience and faithfulness.

questions.question: At what location did the children of Judah come to Joshua, and who spoke to him there?
options: Gilgal; Caleb the son of Jephunneh
questions.correctAnswer: Gilgal; Caleb the son of Jephunneh
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:6 specifies that the children of Judah came to Joshua in Gilgal, where Caleb spoke to him, introducing his request based on prior promises.

questions.question: How old was Caleb when Moses sent him to spy out the land, and what did he do with the report?
options: Forty years old; he brought word as it was in his heart
Thirty years old; he withheld the truth
Fifty years old; he feared the giants
Twenty years old; he doubted the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Forty years old; he brought word as it was in his heart
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:7 tells us Caleb was forty when sent to spy the land and that he gave an honest report, showing faithfulness and courage.

questions.question: True or False: Caleb’s brethren encouraged the people, but Caleb followed the LORD wholeheartedly.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:8 contrasts Caleb's faithfulness with his brethren who made the hearts of the people melt, highlighting Caleb's wholehearted trust in God.

questions.question: What was the promise Moses swore to Caleb regarding the land he had walked upon?
options: That land would be his inheritance forever
That he would never see the land
That he would receive gold and silver
questions.correctAnswer: That land would be his inheritance forever
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:9 records Moses' oath that the land where Caleb's feet had trod would be his inheritance and his children's forever, rewarding his faithfulness.

questions.question: How does Joshua 14:10 teach about God's faithfulness in keeping promises over time?
options: The LORD kept Caleb alive for 45 years since the promise
Caleb forgot the promise and made a new one
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD kept Caleb alive for 45 years since the promise
questions.explanation: Verse 10 shows God's faithfulness as He kept Caleb alive for 45 years since the promise, emphasizing trust in God's timing and provision.

questions.question: What does Caleb say about his strength at age 85 in Joshua 14:11?
options: His strength remains as when he was 40, ready for war
He is too weak to fight
He depends on others for protection
questions.correctAnswer: His strength remains as when he was 40, ready for war
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:11 reveals Caleb's remarkable vitality and readiness for battle at age 85, showing his enduring faith and physical strength.

questions.question: True or False: Caleb requested the mountain where the Anakims lived because he trusted the LORD would help him drive them out.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:12 shows Caleb's faith in God's help, requesting the mountain inhabited by the Anakims with confidence in victory if the LORD is with him.

questions.question: What inheritance did Joshua give to Caleb as a blessing, according to Joshua 14:13?
questions.correctAnswer: Hebron
questions.explanation: Verse 13 states Joshua blessed Caleb and gave him Hebron for an inheritance, fulfilling the promise made to him.

questions.question: How does Joshua 14:14 emphasize the reason Hebron became Caleb's inheritance?
options: Because Caleb wholly followed the LORD God of Israel
Because Caleb was the eldest son
Because Caleb was the strongest warrior
Because Caleb paid for the land
questions.correctAnswer: Because Caleb wholly followed the LORD God of Israel
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:14 highlights Caleb’s wholehearted faithfulness as the reason for his inheritance of Hebron, teaching faithfulness is rewarded.

questions.question: What was the former name of Hebron and who was Arba as mentioned in Joshua 14:15?
options: Kirjatharba; a great man among the Anakims
questions.correctAnswer: Kirjatharba; a great man among the Anakims
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:15 identifies Hebron's former name as Kirjatharba and Arba as a great man among the Anakims, providing historical context.

hard.title: Joshua Chapter 14 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Joshua Chapter 14.

questions.question: What reason does Caleb give for still being strong enough for war at age 85?
options: Because he followed the LORD wholly
Because he stayed in good health
questions.correctAnswer: Because he followed the LORD wholly
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:11 states Caleb's strength is as it was when Moses sent him, implying divine favor for his obedience. Joshua 14:14 confirms this is because he 'wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.'

questions.question: In Joshua 14:12, what is Caleb’s condition for being able to drive out the Anakims?
options: If he is given more troops
If the LORD will be with him
If the mountain is not too high
If the cities are not fenced
questions.correctAnswer: If the LORD will be with him
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:12 explicitly states Caleb’s confidence depends on the LORD’s presence to enable him to drive out the Anakims.

questions.question: Which city did Joshua give to Caleb as his inheritance?
questions.correctAnswer: Hebron
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:13 records Joshua blessing Caleb and giving him Hebron as his inheritance.

questions.question: What was Hebron called before it was named Hebron?
questions.correctAnswer: Kirjatharba
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:15 states the former name of Hebron was Kirjatharba, linked to Arba, a great man among the Anakims.

questions.question: What is the significance of Caleb’s inheritance being given to him "unto this day"?
options: It marked a lasting fulfillment of God’s promise
It was a gift from the Philistines
questions.correctAnswer: It marked a lasting fulfillment of God’s promise
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:14 indicates the inheritance endured 'unto this day' because Caleb wholly followed the LORD, showing God’s faithfulness to His promises.

questions.question: How many years had Caleb been alive since the LORD spoke to Moses about his inheritance?
questions.correctAnswer: 45 years
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:10 states Caleb had been alive 45 years since the LORD spoke the word to Moses about his inheritance.

questions.question: What literary device is evident in the way Caleb’s faithfulness is highlighted by the repetition of his strength and inheritance?
questions.correctAnswer: Chiasmus
questions.explanation: The chapter uses chiasmus by paralleling Caleb’s unwavering faith and strength with the promise of inheritance, emphasizing the cause and effect relationship (Joshua 14:11-14).

questions.question: True or False: The Anakims were described as weak and easily driven out.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:12 describes the Anakims as inhabitants of great and fenced cities, making them formidable opponents.

questions.question: True or False: Caleb’s confidence in conquering the mountain depended on God’s presence, reflecting reliance on divine strength rather than human might.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:12 shows Caleb’s trust that if the LORD is with him, he can drive out the Anakims, illustrating faith in God’s power.

questions.question: Which other Old Testament book echoes Caleb’s faith and inheritance promise?
questions.correctAnswer: Numbers
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:24 also records God’s promise to Caleb for his faithfulness, connecting directly with Joshua 14:9 and 14:14.

questions.question: The Hebrew word 'Kenezite' in Caleb’s title indicates what about his background?
options: He was a descendant of Kenaz, a clan within Judah
questions.correctAnswer: He was a descendant of Kenaz, a clan within Judah
questions.explanation: The term 'Kenezite' (Joshua 14:6) refers to Caleb’s ancestry from the Kenaz clan, a part of the tribe of Judah, highlighting his tribal identity.

questions.question: What was the purpose of dividing the land by lot as mentioned in Joshua 14:2?
options: To follow the LORD’s command through Moses
To give the best land to the priests
questions.correctAnswer: To follow the LORD’s command through Moses
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:2 explains the land was distributed by lot as the LORD commanded through Moses, ensuring divine guidance in the allocation.

questions.question: Cross-referencing Joshua 14 with Acts 13, which New Testament figure references Caleb’s faithfulness as an example?
questions.correctAnswer: Paul
questions.explanation: In Acts 13:22, Paul highlights David’s heart like Caleb’s, demonstrating faithfulness to God, echoing Joshua 14’s theme of wholehearted obedience.

questions.question: How does the inheritance of Caleb in Joshua 14:13-14 fulfill the earlier promise made by Moses?
options: It was a reward for his military skills
It was a direct fulfillment of the oath Moses swore
It was given because he was the oldest
It was chosen by the other tribes
questions.correctAnswer: It was a direct fulfillment of the oath Moses swore
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:9 records Moses swearing Caleb would have the land he walked on; Joshua 14:13-14 shows this promise fulfilled.

questions.question: Which tribe did Caleb belong to according to Joshua 14:6?
questions.correctAnswer: Judah
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:6 states the children of Judah came to Joshua, and Caleb, a member of Judah, spoke to him.

theological.title: Joshua Chapter 14 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Joshua Chapter 14 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: According to Joshua 14:1, who were responsible for distributing the land inheritance among the tribes of Israel?
options: Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the tribes
questions.correctAnswer: Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the tribes
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:1 explicitly states that Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes distributed the land inheritance among the children of Israel.

questions.question: What principle governed the allocation of the land inheritance among the tribes as described in Joshua 14:2?
options: By lot as commanded by the LORD through Moses
By population size of each tribe
According to the tribe's military strength
Based on the seniority of each tribe
questions.correctAnswer: By lot as commanded by the LORD through Moses
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:2 states that the inheritance was given by lot, following the command of the LORD through Moses, indicating divine sovereignty and impartiality in the distribution.

questions.question: Which tribe(s) received no land inheritance in Canaan but were instead given cities to dwell in, according to Joshua 14:4?
questions.correctAnswer: The Levites
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:4 clarifies that the Levites received no land inheritance among the tribes but were given cities with their suburbs for dwelling and cattle, reflecting their unique priestly role and dependence on God.

questions.question: What does Caleb's declaration in Joshua 14:7-8 reveal about his faith and obedience during the spying mission?
options: He wholly followed the LORD, unlike his brethren whose report caused fear
He feared the giants and doubted God's promise
He remained silent during the mission
He led the people to rebel against Moses
questions.correctAnswer: He wholly followed the LORD, unlike his brethren whose report caused fear
questions.explanation: In verses 7-8, Caleb states that while his brethren's report caused the people to lose heart, he wholly followed the LORD, demonstrating steadfast faith and obedience.

questions.question: What divine attribute is demonstrated by God's promise to Caleb in Joshua 14:9, that the land he trod on would be his and his children's forever?
questions.correctAnswer: Faithfulness to His promises
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:9 shows God's faithfulness, as He swore that Caleb's inheritance would be his and his descendants' forever because Caleb wholly followed the LORD.

questions.question: How does Caleb's report of his strength at age 85 in Joshua 14:11 help us understand the doctrine of sanctification?
options: God sustains and empowers His faithful for continued service
Old age is a sign of divine rejection
questions.correctAnswer: God sustains and empowers His faithful for continued service
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:11 reflects that Caleb's strength remains as when he was younger, indicating God's sustaining grace enabling believers to serve Him effectively throughout life, a key aspect of sanctification.

questions.question: What theological significance does the giving of Hebron to Caleb in Joshua 14:13-14 have in the context of divine reward?
options: It symbolizes God's reward for wholehearted faithfulness
It marks the first city conquered by Joshua
It represents a tribal capital city
It was a gift bestowed due to Caleb's wealth
questions.correctAnswer: It symbolizes God's reward for wholehearted faithfulness
questions.explanation: Verses 13-14 show that Joshua blessed Caleb and gave him Hebron as an inheritance because Caleb wholly followed the LORD, illustrating that God rewards faithful obedience.

questions.question: What does Joshua 14:3 teach about the Levites' unique role and inheritance among the tribes of Israel?
options: They received no land inheritance but were given cities to dwell in
They obtained the largest land portion
They were given lands on the other side of Jordan
They shared equally with other tribes
questions.correctAnswer: They received no land inheritance but were given cities to dwell in
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:3 explains that the Levites were given no inheritance in the land, highlighting their special priestly function which required dependence on God rather than land ownership.

questions.question: Combining Joshua 14:5 and Joshua 14:10, what doctrine is illustrated by Israel’s obedience and God’s preservation of Caleb?
options: God’s covenant faithfulness and human responsibility
questions.correctAnswer: God’s covenant faithfulness and human responsibility
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:5 shows Israel’s obedience in dividing the land, while 14:10 shows God keeping Caleb alive. Together they illustrate God’s faithfulness to His covenant promises and the necessity of human faithfulness.

questions.question: How does Joshua 14:12 reveal Caleb's confidence in God's power against formidable enemies, and which divine attribute does it emphasize?
options: Caleb trusts God's omnipotence to drive out the Anakims
Caleb relies on his own military skill
Caleb fears defeat and asks for peace
Caleb refuses the mountain because of giants
questions.correctAnswer: Caleb trusts God's omnipotence to drive out the Anakims
questions.explanation: In Joshua 14:12, Caleb expresses confidence that if the LORD is with him, he can conquer the Anakims, highlighting God's omnipotence in enabling victory over great obstacles.

questions.question: What broader narrative arc concerning the Promised Land does Joshua 14:15 conclude with, regarding the land’s rest from war?
options: It signifies fulfillment of God's promise of rest after conquest
The land remained in constant war
Israel lost the land shortly after
questions.correctAnswer: It signifies fulfillment of God's promise of rest after conquest
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:15 notes that the land had rest from war, showing the fulfillment of God's promise to give His people rest in the Promised Land, a key moment in the redemptive history.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal truth do Joshua 14:6 and Joshua 14:9 teach about divine promise and human faithfulness?
options: God’s promises are confirmed to those who fully trust and obey Him
Faithfulness is unnecessary for receiving God’s promises
God’s promises are conditional on human strength alone
questions.correctAnswer: God’s promises are confirmed to those who fully trust and obey Him
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:6 recounts Caleb's confidence in God's word, and 14:9 records Moses' oath that Caleb’s faithfulness secured his inheritance, teaching that God confirms promises to those who wholly trust Him.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that human longevity and strength as seen in Caleb’s life are merely natural phenomena. What does Joshua 14:10-11 actually teach about Caleb's vitality at age 85?
options: It is a testimony to God’s sustaining grace and fulfillment of His word
It is purely a result of human health practices
It demonstrates the superiority of ancient diets
questions.correctAnswer: It is a testimony to God’s sustaining grace and fulfillment of His word
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:10-11 emphasizes that the LORD kept Caleb alive and strong as part of fulfilling His promise, showing divine providence rather than mere natural causes.

questions.question: What does Joshua 14:2-3 teach about the nature of God’s justice in distributing the land among the tribes?
options: God distributes according to His sovereign and just plan, with special provision for the Levites
God gave more land to the Levites than others
The distribution was random without divine order
God favored the largest tribes with the most land
questions.correctAnswer: God distributes according to His sovereign and just plan, with special provision for the Levites
questions.explanation: These verses show that God commanded land distribution by lot, ensuring fairness, while making special provision for the Levites’ priestly role, demonstrating divine justice and sovereignty.

questions.question: What theological insight is gained by synthesizing Joshua 14:9 and Joshua 14:14 about the permanence of God’s promises?
options: God’s promises to faithful followers endure forever and affect their descendants
God’s promises are temporary and limited to one generation
Promises depend on human merit and can be revoked
questions.correctAnswer: God’s promises to faithful followers endure forever and affect their descendants
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:9 records God’s oath that Caleb’s land would be his and his children’s forever, and 14:14 confirms Hebron remained Caleb’s inheritance because of his faithfulness, highlighting the enduring covenantal promise.
